hero.title: 学习辅导应用
hero.summary: 面向长期学习辅导的具体应用，先摄入资料与学习背景，再持续跟踪学习状态并主动推进学习。

taskTemplates.title: 启动学习辅导
taskTemplates.goal: 输入学习者背景、材料和本次目标，让应用设计辅导路径并跟踪掌握情况。
taskTemplates.description: 适合资料摄入后的持续学习辅导。
taskTemplates.currentObjective: 完成一次学习辅导循环

hero.title: Learning Coach
hero.summary: A focused application for sustained learning support. It first takes in materials and learner context, then tracks learning state and proactively advances the work.

taskTemplates.description: For ongoing learning support after materials have been added.
